You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a very small TLA+ system over a single state variable x. It defines a recursively specified function-like operator F over the set {1,2,3,4,5}, a state/action-style operator N indexed by {1,2,3}, a temporal specification Spec constraining x initially and requiring all steps to satisfy an existentially quantified indexed action under stuttering, and an invariant Inv relating x to values of F. The spec uses no explicit fault model, no fairness conditions, and no proofs; its notable feature is the recursive-function-style definition syntax and a simple temporal formula of the form [][A]_x.

Your module MUST define these names so the configuration binds:
